method.binary: codex-cli 0.153.4 installed with npm into a scratch folder (not global); the global install on this PC had already moved to 0.157.1
method.flags: model gpt-5.6-luna, reasoning effort low, approval on-request, sandbox read-only; config overrides on the command line only: no update check, the user config MCP servers switched off, the scratch folder trusted in memory
method.home: the normal CODEX_HOME (its own login); nothing written to its config except the TUI model notice counter every start writes
method.driver: test/mobile/fakes/capture-real-screens.js <scratch> codex and codextrust (capture-real-fixround.js), node-pty at 120 by 30, the same bytes Workbook writes

findings.F1: An open command approval takes a bracketed paste as keys: the paste of "1 hello" approved the command and " hello" landed in the composer. Workbook therefore reads the screen once more right before every paste (send-queue deliver).
findings.F31: task_started appears in the rollout about 60 ms after the submit, before the busy line (about 120 ms); task_complete appears 0 to 425 ms after the reply is on screen (10 samples).
findings.X3: One ESC while busy writes event_msg turn_aborted with reason interrupted about 77 ms later; the X3 rule stays on turn_aborted, and the 5 s fallback covers a missing record.
findings.delivery: Paste, 80 ms, then a lone CR submits (the turn started 265 ms after the CR); the paste draws about 120 ms after it is written.
findings.commands: 51 built in slash commands (results.slashCommands), pinned in chat/commands.js.
findings.bracketedPaste: The idle composer turns bracketed paste mode on (ESC [?2004h seen, xterm mode on), so gate G7 passes for Codex panes.
